name: Technitium DNS
description: Feature-packed DNS server: recursive resolver, authoritative zones, DNS-over-HTTPS, blocking lists and detailed query logs in a clean web UI.
compose:
services:
  technitium:
    image: technitium/dns-server:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:5380/tcp"
      - "${{cfg.dns_port}}:53/udp"
      - "${{cfg.dns_port}}:53/tcp"
    environment:
      DNS_SERVER_DOMAIN: "${{cfg.domain}}"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/etc/dns
    restart: unless-stopped
